'''Viridia''' is a continent in the Avant world. In the 1994-back lore set, it is most important as the geographic setting containing the [[Bakorian War]] and the northern security competition around [[Astoria]], [[Bakorian Republic|Bakoria]], and the [[Northern Alliance]].

== Northern Viridia ==

The Bakorian War source places the conflict in northern Viridia. The region included Astorian military expansion, Bakorian republican resistance, Northern Alliance covert support, and later anti-Astorian escalation.

== Source Limits ==

The extracted source set currently provides Viridia mainly through references, not a full geography article. This bridge page preserves the regional anchor without fixing final continental borders, coastlines, or map subdivisions.
